quests.title: Short Delivery, Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. The Westmead Hospital order has been two cartons light every week since school holidays and the invoice says otherwise every time. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $82 owing to Westmead Hospital and it is not going to walk in here itself. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $82, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Westmead Hospital Run
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I do the Westmead Hospital run at the back of seven and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Childrens Hospital
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I have got a bucket of odd keys in the back of the van and the Westmead Hospital shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Three of the Westmead Hospital regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $92 down on those days. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$92, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Everything Westmead Hospital sells comes off a floor at Ngara, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Woolooware
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Woolooware on a Tuesday and one of them has a note from his mother. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Woolooware
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. We found a twelfth, which means the Woolooware club now owes the association $129 it had budgeted on not owing. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $129 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Woolooware Canteen
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. The canteen at Woolooware does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at half six. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Woolooware
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Somebody walked off with the float from the Woolooware canteen at about half six during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$12, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Woolooware
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The sprinkler line under the Woolooware outfield has been leaking since a Tuesday and the wet patch has started to move. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Woolooware
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Cronulla, and Woolooware has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind West Ryde
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind West Ryde since the first of the month and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, West Ryde
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They have agreed to a clean-up at West Ryde, which is wonderful, except the grant is $144 short and closes on the first of the month. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $144, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, West Ryde
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. We had 33 sandbags in the West Ryde shed on the first of the month and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, West Ryde
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. People keep driving the low crossing at West Ryde at the second express with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, West Ryde
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The water came through my place at West Ryde on the first of the month and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, West Ryde
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Whatever is happening to West Ryde starts upstream at Denistone, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
